outcome_codes:
"positive" = learned image/dynamics features carry information about the
modality beyond the simple baseline named in the row (CI excludes zero gain, or exact
test p < 0.05 with every group in the same direction); "null" = tested, no such gain;
"not tested" = data exist but the test could not be run; "absent" = no public pairing.

rows.dataset: Tay lab deposit, Zenodo 14337874 (live-cell NF-κB reporter, 125 wells)
rows.test: 11-way ligand-pair identity from single-cell traces, well-grouped
rows.result: trace JEPA BA 0.286, raw trace 0.269, hand-crafted 0.198; reference: chance 0.091. Pretraining adds nothing over the same network at random initialisation

rows.dataset: Tay deposit, LPS then LPS (4 wells)
rows.test: tolerant vs naive from the second response; power analysis
rows.result: unpowered (2 wells per arm); 8 wells per arm needed for 80% power at the observed effect

rows.dataset: Tay RNA-seq GSE260996 (same lab as the imaging; 5 conditions)
rows.test: condition-level dynamics -> RNA (Q2 vs leave-one-out mean)
rows.result: fraction of top-2,000 genes with Q2 > 0: 0.226 (exact permutation p 0.36; 5 conditions, descriptive)
fraction of top-2,000 peaks with Q2 > 0: 0.182 (exact permutation p 0.44; 5 conditions, descriptive)

rows.dataset: GSE212282, GSE185433, GSE141656 (human macrophage training and tolerance, RNA only; no images)
rows.result: β-glucan-trained cells: TNF transcript lower at 4 h after LPS (3/3 donors) and after M. tuberculosis (3/3, independent donors)

rows.dataset: Tay mouse RNA (priming x LPS) vs GSE185433 human tolerance
rows.test: overlap of priming-blunted LPS genes among genes induced in both species
rows.result: overlap 18 vs 24.5 expected, OR 0.58, two-sided p 0.09
